cases.name: Actual source schemas enable owner RLS and expose SELECT only to authenticated clients
Each real owner reads only their source rows; cross-owner IDs return no payload
Anonymous reads cannot disclose A3 response text or A4 decisions and signal provenance
Authenticated source INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE remain denied even for the current owner
